newsitems.title: Bless You Again Demo Now Available
newsitems.author: Gulitu
newsitems.contents: Bless You Again Demo Now Available on Steam The Bless You Again demo is now available on Steam. You can download it for free from the store page below. Demo store page:What's in the Demo The demo includes the prologue of the story and the first dungeon, the Ruins of the Stone Seekers. • Freely explore the Ruins of the Stone Seekers, the first of the five dungeons in the full game • Fight as Lily, the protagonist, together with the spirit Yoru • Try the core systems: Blessings, Skills, and combat builds • Keep exploring the dungeon after clearing the prologue The cutscenes included here make up about 5% of the full game's main story cutscenes, and the gameplay covers about 30% of the full game's systems. Lily's fate, the stories of the four spirits, and the characters and secrets we haven't revealed yet are waiting for you in the full game. Please Leave a ReviewAfter playing, we'd love to hear what you think in a review on the demo's store page.Whether it's what you enjoyed or what bothered you, your feedback will help us shape the full game. About the Full GameThe full game will add more characters, dungeons, Skills, and Blessings, and expand the existing systems. A first playthrough of the main story is expected to take around 8 to 10 hours, and the game features full Japanese voice acting. Please also add the full game to your wishlist. Notes• Demo save data will not carry over to the full game • Supported languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Russian, Spanish • See the store page for system requirements • Bug fixes and adjustments will be made through demo updates Bug Reports and Detailed Feedback If you run into bugs, or have detailed feedback or suggestions that won't fit in a review, you can also reach us here.• Feedback survey: https://forms.gle/6xEV4oPoNZZ7AJ6X8 • Discord community: https://discord.gg/DQjGMXSv3D • Steam Discussions (pinned threads for bug reports and for feedback and suggestions): https://steamcommunity.com/app/3530630/discussions/ Follow Us on X and Discord for the Latest News Official X: https://x.com/projectlilyBYA Discord: https://discord.gg/DQjGMXSv3DThank you for playing Bless You Again!

newsitems.title: Bless You Again Demo Planned for Next Week!
newsitems.author: Gulitu
newsitems.contents: We're planning to release the Bless You Again demo next week!In this demo, you can experience the prologue, featuring roughly 5% of the full game's total main-story cutscene content.In terms of gameplay, the demo lets you experience roughly 30% of what the full game's gameplay systems have to offer.You'll be able to:Freely explore the first of the full game's five dungeonsFight as two playable characters, Lily and YoruExperience core gameplay features, including blessings, skills, and combat buildsContinue exploring the dungeon and enjoying the demo's content after completing the prologueThe full game will introduce more characters, dungeons, skills, and blessings, along with expanded features for the existing systems.A first playthrough of the main story in the full version of Bless You Again is expected to take approximately 8–10 hours. The game will also feature full Japanese voice acting.The demo shows only a small part of the world of Bless You Again.Lily's fate, the stories of four spirits, and characters and secrets yet to be revealed are all waiting for you.

newsitems.title: Playtest Version Updated

newsitems.contents: Hi everyone! newsitems.title: Limited-time Alpha Playtest starts now!
newsitems.author: Gino
newsitems.contents: Limited-Time Playtest Now Live!Thanks so much for taking an interest in our new game, “Bless You Again.”January 5, we’re running a Steam Playtest to collect your feedback and impressions on the current prototype build.You can play it until January 31!Join the playtest from the Steam store page!We’re not a veteran team with a long track record. That’s exactly why feedback from people who actually play the game means the world to us.(Share your feedback via this link.)The game is still in the early stages of development, but we’d be really grateful if you could give it a try and share your honest thoughts.How to PlayIn this game, you explore each stage while aiming to reach higher and higher floors. The basic flow goes like this:Explore the stage → Power up through level-ups and treasure chests → Head to the next floor!As you progress, you’ll come across different objects along the way:Treasure Chests: If you find one while exploring, you can open it on the spot to claim your rewards.Green Effect: This means HP recovery—just walk near it to heal.Door to the Next Floor: At the end of each stage, a door labeled “NEXT” will appear. Enter it to move on to the next floor.In this test build, there are 10 floors in total. Aim for the top and see how far you can make it!Checking the ControlsIf you want to review the controls, you can check them anytime with the steps below:① Press ESC (keyboard) or the Options button (controller) to open the pause menu.② Click “Tutorial” in the menu.From there, you can view all controls for movement, combat, skills, and more. You don’t need to memorize everything—feel free to check whenever you need and enjoy exploring at your own pace!Notes ・Fairy Mode can’t be used until the gauge is fully charged.└ While in Fairy Mode, your Physical Attack and Magic Attack are boosted.・There is no parry right now. (We haven’t decided what we’ll do in the future yet…)・If you successfully perform a Perfect Dodge, you’ll recover MP.・This demo does not include the story part.We’d Love Your Feedback!If you played the test and can share your thoughts or anything you’d like to see fixed, please let us know through this link.The game is still very much in development, so we believe we can reflect your feedback in the full release.We’d really appreciate your honest opinions—thank you!

newsitems.title: Crowdfunding Completed – Thank You!
newsitems.author: kyo
newsitems.contents: 【Crowdfunding Completed – Thank You!】Our crowdfunding campaign for Bless You Again has officially ended on June 30th!Thanks to incredible support from our Japanese community, we successfully raised over $68,000.Please note that the campaign was limited to residents of Japan, so unfortunately international fans were not able to contribute directly.However, your interest and encouragement from around the world mean a great deal to us.We’re truly grateful to everyone supporting Bless You Again!The development team will now be working full speed ahead to deliver the best experience possible.We’ll continue to share updates here and on our X (formerly Twitter) account:Official X (Twitter): https://x.com/projectlilyBYAThank you again, and please look forward to more!

newsitems.title: Full Voice Acting Achieved & Onward to Costume Additions!
newsitems.author: kyo
newsitems.contents: We’re sorry, but this crowdfunding campaign is only available within Japan.\There are only 18 days left in our current crowdfunding campaign!Thanks to your incredible support, we've surpassed 5 million yen in funding — and full voice acting has officially been confirmed!Thank you so much!Our next stretch goals are:At 7.5 million yen: A new dungeon will be addedAt 10 million yen: New character costumes will be addedWe’re aiming to make the game even more fun and fulfilling to play!In addition, we’re planning to release an exclusive demo for backers in July! It’s your chance to be among the first to try the game — so please consider supporting us while there’s still time!▼ Crowdfunding campaign page 👉 https://camp-fire.jp/projects/837148/view?utm_campaign=cp_po_share_c_msg_mypage_projects_showWe also post more frequent updates on X (formerly Twitter), so be sure to check it out: 👉 https://x.com/projectlilyBYA

newsitems.title: Our first gameplay footage is now live!
newsitems.author: kyo
newsitems.contents: On May 4th, we showcased our prototype at an indie game event in Japan and had players try out the early demo. https://x.com/projectlilyBYA/status/1918591363253227540 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525318/bf6f493253c9e967849aa54a9fce13f27e691f97.png In this version, they could: ・View the character ・Use melee attacks ・Use magic attacks ・Move and jump That’s it for now — it's still an early prototype, not yet fully functional. Even so, we received tons of valuable feedback, and the experience was incredibly helpful! Today, we'd also like to share the current development roadmap that we presented during the event: By June 20: → Complete a full prototype (with placeholder assets) By September 30: → Complete a playable demo for Steam Next Fest Here’s what we plan to include in the prototype by June 20: ・Upgrade system ・Aerial attacks ・Machine gun-style magic ・Grenade-style magic ・Four elemental magic types ・Shift into fire/water/wind/ground mode * ・Boss battle ・Puzzle mechanics ・Improved enemy AI *{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525318/4d62e44c1dbf61b0927f651b6bdfa409202c5c68.png We’ll continue development in this direction, and we also plan to post here more frequently. Thanks for your continued support!
